arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# High-grade corporate bond yields
feb_1943 = 2.68
feb_1944 = 2.65
jan_1945 = 2.58

# Benchmark
benchmark = 2.60

# Calculate absolute differences
diff_1943 = abs(feb_1943 - benchmark)
diff_1944 = abs(feb_1944 - benchmark)
diff_1945 = abs(jan_1945 - benchmark)

print(f'February 1943: |{feb_1943} - {benchmark}| = {diff_1943}')
print(f'February 1944: |{feb_1944} - {benchmark}| = {diff_1944}')
print(f'January 1945:  |{jan_1945} - {benchmark}| = {diff_1945}')

# Calculate average deviation
avg_deviation = (diff_1943 + diff_1944 + diff_1945) / 3
print(f'\nAverage deviation: ({diff_1943} + {diff_1944} + {diff_1945}) / 3 = {avg_deviation:.4f}')
print(f'Rounded to 2 decimal places: {avg_deviation:.2f}')
"
